title: On Compatible Generalization Bounds of Deep Residual Networks From a Dynamical System Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2602.20921v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have significantly advanced machine learning, with model depth playing a central role in their successes. Deep residual networks (ResNets) fall into one of the most important classes of DNNs. In this paper, we study the compatible generalization behavior of deep residual networks with a broad class of activation functions in the deep-layer limit, from a dynamical system perspective. We first show a refined contraction inequality for Rademacher complexity of function classes composed by that type of activation functions. We then conduct an equivalence analysis of component hypothesis sets in Rademacher complexity and forward convergence analysis of network state variables, which enable us to establish compatible uniform generalization bounds that simultaneously achieve the optimal \(O(1/\sqrt{S})\) sample rate for both discrete- and continuous-time ResNets. translated_title: 从动力系统视角研究深度残差网络的相容泛化界
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNNs）极大地推动了机器学习的发展，其中模型深度在其成功中扮演着核心角色。深度残差网络（ResNets）是最重要的深度神经网络类别之一。本文从动力系统的视角，研究了在深层极限下、具有广泛一类激活函数的深度残差网络的相容泛化行为。我们首先针对由这类激活函数构成的函数类，给出了一个精细化的 Rademacher 复杂度收缩不等式。随后，我们对 Rademacher 复杂度中的分量假设集进行了等价性分析，并对网络状态变量进行了前向收敛性分析，从而使我们能够建立相容的一致泛化界，该泛化界同时对离散时间和连续时间的 ResNets 都达到了最优的 O(1/√S) 样本复杂度。这些界还具有共同的层数无关性。
tldr: 本文从动力系统视角出发，通过精细的Rademacher复杂度收缩不等式与分量假设集等价性分析，为离散和连续时间深度残差网络建立了同时达到最优O(1/√S)样本率且与层数无关的相容一致泛化界。
en_tdlr: From a dynamical system perspective, this paper establishes compatible uniform generalization bounds for both discrete- and continuous-time deep residual networks that simultaneously achieve the optimal O(1/√S) sample rate and are independent of the number of layers, via a refined Rademacher complexity contraction inequality and equivalence analysis of component hypothesis sets.
